scope: Independent regular-GUI light-image and native workflow validation; not a sealed exam
reference: Independent CPU area integration from exported camera, emitter and diffuse receiver USD attributes; all finite emitter geometry remains opaque including zero-power shapes. Pixel centers are fixed from camera/geometry, never selected by candidate RGB.
bounce_scope: Although GUI settings request four extra bounces, the judge requires exactly two diffuse meshes, both coplanar at worldZ0 with +Z geometric/generated normals and no authored normal override. Scattered rays cannot hit another diffuse surface; analytic emitters terminate paths. Direct-only transport is exact for this restricted fixture, not a claim for arbitrary multipath scenes.
statistics: SE is sample standard deviation of per-pixel candidate-minus-independent-reference residuals divided by sqrt(number of fixed interior sample pixels). It estimates Monte Carlo mean uncertainty across decorrelated pixels; numerical floor accounts for quadrature and one-pixel filter approximation. Both fixed ceilings also apply.
workflow: Reparse raw session/request/present/batch/pause logs independently; require unfinished-render ACK, no work until resume, edited current image, unchanged capture generation, restored previous renderer/pause/grid and isolated second viewer.
